notes: First JSON-first preview; not merged into main and not a production integration claim.

Generation resolves Jira routing/field metadata and writes the final story.json4jira before scoring. SPEC remains Markdown; the standalone STORY.md is replaced by the JSON business projection inside SPEC.
User-confirmed scorer is nodejs-base-mcp.scoreUserStory with story_json_workspace_path, specFileStatus and specFilePath. This clarification supersedes the screenshot scoring one-argument example.
Export retains java-base-mcp.exportJiraByDynamicFields but uses only the same story_json_workspace_path. Backend linkage/queue replaces the old Agent B call.
Story score stays in its independent report/UI. No SPEC score mutation or display-driven S2. Full responses and unknown outcomes are preserved.
Shared content quality and independent review remain; destination assembly precedes scoring, final content confirmation follows scoring.
Update target, none/replace and score-only-attachment handling require active backend schema evidence; unsupported cases wait rather than fabricate fields or create a new ticket.
Independent Jira helper, Story reviewer and review-requirements directories are unchanged. Their backend compatibility was not validated here.
Actual model, preview, database, attachment and asynchronous score-sync behavior requires platform integration testing.
